reconstructed_captions.30: He carries the propellant charge tube with both hands.
reconstructed_captions.31: Another soldier on the truck bed reaches out to take the charge from him.
reconstructed_captions.32: The first soldier hands the charge up to the second soldier.
reconstructed_captions.33: The second soldier takes the charge and turns around on the truck bed.
reconstructed_captions.34: He carefully places the propellant charge onto a growing stack.
reconstructed_captions.35: The first soldier looks back towards the rack to grab another charge.
